verdict.rationale: Headless and CI operation is a fair axis for an OS, but the evidence only glances at it. One user runs Fedora Workstation on a home media server managed through Cockpit (fedora-comm-6), and Fedora publishes Container_Toolbox and WSL release images (fedora-docs-18, fedora-docs-19). Both images are broader Fedora artifacts rather than documented Workstation headless or CI automation. Missing for 10: first-party docs on headless or unattended operation of Workstation, CI-ready images or usage guidance, automation or unattended-install documentation, and hands-on CI corroboration.
